# -*- coding: utf-8 -*- import dataiku import pandas as pd, numpy as np from dataiku import pandasutils as pdu from dataiku.scenario import Scenario from urllib.parse import urljoin client = dataiku.api_client() try: external_url = client.get_general_settings().get_raw()["studioExternalUrl"] except: external_url = None sol_project_key = dataiku.get_custom_variables()["projectKey"] variables = client.get_project(sol_project_key).get_variables() continuous_build_message_sender = variables["local"]["continuous_build_message_sender"] if continuous_build_message_sender: scenario = Scenario() message_sender = scenario.get_message_sender(continuous_build_message_sender) over_budget_notifications = dataiku.Dataset("over_budget_notifications") over_budget_notifications_df = over_budget_notifications.get_dataframe() not_notified_df = over_budget_notifications_df[ (over_budget_notifications_df["hasTwentyPercentBudgetLeft"] == 1) & (over_budget_notifications_df["twentyPercentLeftNotificationSent"] == False) ] if len(not_notified_df) > 0: not_notified_df["operationalManager"] = not_notified_df["operationalManager"].str.split(";") not_notified_df["projectOwner"] = not_notified_df["projectOwner"].str.split(";") group_operational_manager = not_notified_df.explode("operationalManager").groupby("operationalManager") group_project_owner = not_notified_df.explode("projectOwner").groupby("projectOwner") for name, group in group_operational_manager: operational_manager_mail_content = f""" Hello {name},

The following projects you oversee consumed more than 80% of their allocated budget:

""" for index, row in group.iterrows(): project_key = row["projectKey"] budget_usd = row["budgetUSD"] consumed_usd = row["llmUsage_estimatedCostUSD_sum"] if isinstance(row["projectOwner"], list): project_owner = " ".join(row["projectOwner"]) else: project_owner = "(none)" operational_manager_mail_content += f""" Project {project_key}
{consumed_usd} / {budget_usd} USD consumed.
Project owner(s) {project_owner}.

""" if external_url: dashboard_part = f"projects/{sol_project_key}/dashboards/" operational_manager_mail_content += f""" For more details, go to dashboards {urljoin(external_url, dashboard_part)}

""" operational_manager_mail_content += """ Best regards,
Dataiku LLM Cost Guard """ message_sender.send( subject=f"Dataiku LLM Cost Guard: projects beyond 80% budget.", message=operational_manager_mail_content, sendAsHTML=True, recipient=name) for name, group in group_project_owner: project_owner_mail_content = f""" Hello {name},

The following projects you own consumed more than 80% of their allocated budget:

""" for index, row in group.iterrows(): project_key = row["projectKey"] budget_usd = row["budgetUSD"] consumed_usd = row["llmUsage_estimatedCostUSD_sum"] if isinstance(row["operationalManager"], list): operational_manager = " ".join(row["operationalManager"]) else: operational_manager = "(none)" project_owner_mail_content += f""" Project {project_key}
{consumed_usd} / {budget_usd} USD consumed.
Operational manager(s) {operational_manager}.

""" if external_url: dashboard_part = f"projects/{sol_project_key}/dashboards/" project_owner_mail_content += f""" For more details, go to dashboards {urljoin(external_url, dashboard_part)}

""" project_owner_mail_content += """ Best regards,
Dataiku LLM Cost Guard """ message_sender.send( subject=f"Dataiku LLM Cost Guard: projects beyond 80% budget.", message=project_owner_mail_content, sendAsHTML=True, recipient=name) over_budget_notifications_df.loc[over_budget_notifications_df["hasTwentyPercentBudgetLeft"] == 1, "twentyPercentLeftNotificationSent"] = True over_budget_notifications.write_with_schema(over_budget_notifications_df)
